mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, jointly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS both rising above their 3-month moving averages fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, sustained industrial production above 105.0 indicates robust supply chain activity and capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO above 105.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth above 0.5% monthly fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment decline below 5.0% and employment growth above 0.5% monthly signal accelerating labor market strength, jointly boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling below 5.0% and PAYEMS rising above 0.5% monthly fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic weakness and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through lower earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.
